highlights.headline: Nvidia reports on Tuesday and Anthropic lists on Thursday in the market's biggest AI week.
Mirra Andreeva, 19, won the WTA Finals without dropping a set and ends 2026 as world No. 2.
Rory McIlroy won an eighth Race to Dubai, equalling Montgomerie's record, as Tyrrell Hatton won in Dubai.
Bitcoin dropped to about US$62,000, down 15% in a week, as ETF outflows hit US$1.9 billion.
GTA VI launches Thursday, with reviews reportedly out the day before.
Johnny Depp's Ebenezer took No. 1 as Godzilla Minus Zero fell 75%.
Resale prices hit a 20-week low and New World plans a HK$25 billion rights issue.
Apple's first touchscreen Mac, the OLED MacBook Pro, is shipping.
